mainEntity.name: Does AEO apply differently to general contractors in New York City compared to other regions?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the core principles of AEO (Authority, Expertise, Trustworthiness) remain universal, their application can have local nuances. In competitive markets like New York City, demonstrating AEO might require a stronger emphasis on local reputation, reviews specific to the NYC area, and content addressing unique local building codes or architectural styles. The intensity of competition also means that achieving top AEO signals may require more sustained effort and differentiation compared to less saturated markets.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO principles are universal, but in competitive markets like New York City, local reputation, reviews, and content tailored to regional specifics become more critical.
